task.description:
Write integration tests for ISS-207, ISS-208, ISS-205.

Files to write:
- tests/specs/ISS-207.md + tests/integration/iss207_error_retry_test.zig
- tests/specs/ISS-208.md + tests/integration/iss208_task_guard_test.zig
- tests/specs/ISS-205.md + tests/integration/iss205_webhook_outbox_test.zig

ISS-207 cases: (1) bare retry of error instance rejected with hint; (2) retry-with-input advances instance; (3) discard cancels instance.
ISS-208 cases: (1) cancel instance then attempt task completion → 409, no events appended; (2) race-safe: concurrent cancel+complete only one wins.
ISS-205 cases: (1) event committed → webhook_deliveries row exists in same tx; (2) kill-after-commit: worker delivers on restart; (3) back-off ladder: 5 failures → subscription paused + OBS-06 emitted.

All: real PostgreSQL, per-test UUIDs, no SkipZigTest, no mocks.
acceptance_criteria: All 3 spec files written covering listed cases
Real PostgreSQL only, per-test UUIDs, no mocks

result.summary: Wrote test specs and integration tests for ISS-207 (convergent retry), ISS-208 (task guard), ISS-205 (webhook outbox). All 6 files created. Build exits 0. 14 pre-existing test failures on branch are from ISS-103 work (definition_retrieval_test + test_api08_auth, provisioning schema issue); my changes do not introduce new failures.
